title: Dedicated offline PyTorch Runner checkpoint repair
goal: Use six distinct roles and the dedicated labops/pytorch-cpu-runner:0.1.0 to produce a real, independently verified checkpoint-only repair.
acceptance: RuntimeCapabilityCheck passes runner image, torch, checkpoint, config, path, budget and command checks.
Safe Executor invokes only labops/pytorch-cpu-runner:0.1.0 after human approval; it does not run or install torch in the Worker.
Runner is --network none and produces run_result.json, metrics.json, stdout.log, stderr.log and artifact_manifest.json.
Three reproducible evaluations show baseline about 0.70 and candidate about 0.98125.
metric.py, deterministic validation data and the original workspace remain unchanged.
Only Verification Auditor may return PASS / RESOLVED after independent recomputation and trace/hash verification.
All six roles produce distinct, timestamped handoffs and the evidence bundle hashes verify.
close_rule: Without a concrete runner metric, immutable hashes, human approval and independent verification, remain INCONCLUSIVE or BLOCKED.
